about.title: About Independent Media Network
about.description: Independent Media Network is a Melbourne company that builds and looks after websites for small businesses. Human run, AI powered.
paragraphs: Independent Media Network Pty Ltd is a small Melbourne company run by Simon Farrugia. We build and run our own websites, from a Victorian travel guide to Australian pay calculators, and now we build them for other businesses too.
Every site is built on the same system we use for our own: fast pages on Cloudflare, Google basics done properly, automatic health checks and a dashboard that shows what's working.

We're human run and AI powered. AI tools do the drafting, checking and quick edits, which keeps the price fair. Simon plans each site with the owner, checks every page before it goes live and answers every email.
We keep the offer simple on purpose: one plan, two change rounds a month included, and clear terms. If a job is bigger than a change, we say so and quote it first.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.description: Questions about a website for your business? Email Independent Media Network or send a message. We reply within two business days.
contact.lede: Questions first? Send a message or email us. A person reads every one and replies within two business days.

get-started.title: Get your website started
get-started.description: Tell us about your business in two minutes and we'll build a preview of your new website. Founding offer: no setup fee for our first 10 clients.
get-started.lede: Tell us about your business. We'll reply within two business days with next steps, then build your preview.

privacy-policy.title: Privacy policy
privacy-policy.description: What Independent Media Network collects, why, and who sees it.
paragraphs: Independent Media Network Pty Ltd (Melbourne, Australia) runs this website. This policy explains what we collect and why.

When you fill in a form, we collect the details you give us: your name, email, phone (optional), business name, your website (if you have one) and your message. We use them only to reply to you and, if you go ahead, to build and look after your website.
We don't sell or rent your details, and we don't add you to mailing lists.

For clients, we store the content and settings of your website and, if you choose the dashboard, visit and Google search counts for your site. These are counts, not information about who your visitors are.

To see, correct or delete what we hold about you, email hello@imnetwork.com.au. If you're not happy with how we've handled your information, you can contact the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (oaic.gov.au).

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.description: The terms for Independent Media Network's website plan: what's included, billing, changes, cancelling and who owns what.

p: These terms are between your business and Independent Media Network Pty Ltd ("IMN", "we"), Melbourne, Victoria. They apply when you sign up for our website plan.

The website plan includes: building your website (up to 5 pages), hosting, an SSL certificate, backups of every version, Google basics (page titles, descriptions, a sitemap and Google Search Console), a monthly health check, a private dashboard, and 2 change rounds a month.

A change round is up to 30 minutes of work on small updates to existing pages, sent together in one email. Unused rounds don't carry over. Extra rounds cost $50 + GST each. New pages, redesigns and bigger jobs are quoted first, and we don't start them without your OK.

Your domain name and its yearly fee, email hosting or email accounts, social media, paid advertising, photography, third-party subscriptions (such as booking or shop software), and fixing problems caused by other providers. We're happy to quote for any of these.
The plan costs $99 + GST a month. The setup fee is $499 + GST, once, unless it's waived under an offer. Prices are in Australian dollars and exclude GST unless we say otherwise.

Monthly fees are charged in advance by card, starting the day your site goes live. We send a tax invoice for every payment. If a payment fails, we'll tell you and try again. If it's still unpaid 14 days after we tell you, we may pause your site until it's paid.
We'll give you at least 30 days' written notice of any price change, and you can cancel before it starts.

Our first 10 clients can have the setup fee waived. In return they agree to a 12-month plan from go-live and to let us share a short testimonial and a link to their site. If a founding client cancels before 12 months, they pay the lesser of the waived setup fee ($499 + GST) or the monthly fees left in the 12 months. After 12 months the plan is month to month.
Standard plans are month to month. Tell us by email before your next billing date and we won't charge you again. Your site stays live until the end of the month you've paid for.
When you leave, we send you a copy of your site's files and help you point your domain somewhere else. We don't charge to hand over.

You own your domain name, your business name and logo, and the words and photos you give us or that we write for your site. We own our system, design templates and tools. When you leave, you're free to keep using the site files we hand over.

You confirm the information on your site is accurate and lawful, and that you have the right to use the words, photos and logos you give us. Please check your preview and every change, and tell us if something's wrong.

We take care to keep your site online, secure and backed up, and we reply to emails within two business days. Sites can occasionally be unavailable because of our hosting provider or internet problems; we'll fix anything on our side as quickly as we can.
We help your site follow Google's basics, but no one can promise rankings, visitors or sales, and we don't.
We use AI tools to draft pages, check sites and make changes. A person reviews every page before it goes live and every change before it's published.
We handle your details as set out in our privacy policy. Messages your customers send through your site's forms are kept only to pass them on to you and to look after your site.

Nothing in these terms takes away rights you have under the Australian Consumer Law. As far as the law allows, our total liability to you is limited to the fees you paid us in the 3 months before the claim, and we aren't liable for indirect losses such as lost profits.
We may update these terms. We'll email you at least 30 days before a change that affects you, and you can cancel before it applies. These terms are governed by the laws of Victoria, Australia.
